final_message:
I wrote the five design files to `design/`. Nothing was built, run or measured, and I did not view any images.

- **Files:** `tokens.json`, `tokens.css`, `ui-spec.md` and `visual-plan.json`.
- **Visual direction:** a light automotive marketplace with a dark header and one teal accent. Status colours always come with a text label.
- **App shell:** a header with role-dependent navigation and a "Switch account" select (`account-switcher`). Switching persists the user and returns to `/`.
- **Routes:** `/`, `/cars/:id`, `/my-bookings`, `/owner/listings` (with `/new` and `/:id/edit`), `/owner/requests` and `/owner/earnings`.
- **Test contract:** `ui-spec.md` section 5 lists exact `data-testid`s, labels, input types and options, error texts, and the formats for money, dates and counts. Repeated cards and rows carry `data-id`. It also covers the TR-1 to TR-6 flows and the primary journey.
- **Visual plan:** three targets — `catalog` (renter marketplace), `booking` (`/cars/car_01` with 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-04, ready when `price-total` reads `$280.00`), and `requests` (owner view of the seed booking `book_301`).

**Limitations:**
- Colour pairs are listed in `tokens.json` as expected to meet WCAG AA, but I didn't measure any contrast ratios.
- Car images are remote URLs, so offline runs will show a fallback placeholder.
- The `ui-spec.md` ConfirmDialog entry has muddled button wording. The binding testids are `confirm-yes` (label "Confirm") and `confirm-no` (label "Go back").
